title: Soft-Body Facial Emotion Sculptor
description: The user sculpts soft-body emotion masks onto a face model by transferring deformation energy from Michelle's animated poses. Michelle performs gestures that generate colored soft-body energy orbs, which the user catches and applies to the facecap model's morph targets, blending emotions while conserving total deformation energy across both models. Undo/redo lets the user refine the emotional composition.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net. Load Michelle.glb on the left side and facecap.glb on the right side of the scene. Camera at (0,1.4,3) looking at (0,1.2,0). Use hemisphere light plus directional light with soft shadows. Implement a soft-body energy system: Michelle plays her idle animation and when the user clicks on Michelle, she generates a soft-body orb (a sphere with spring-damper mesh simulation using 42 vertices that wobble and deform as they float). The orb color maps to an emotion: red=anger, blue=sadness, yellow=joy, green=surprise, purple=fear. The user clicks to spawn orbs (up to 3 at once), then drags each orb onto the facecap model. On contact, the orb splashes with a jelly-like deformation animation and its energy transfers to the corresponding morph target on facecap, increasing that blend shape weight. Implement a conservation law: total deformation energy is fixed at 1.0 across all active morph targets. Adding energy to one emotion proportionally reduces others, shown via a HUD bar chart. The user must perform 10-14 steps: spawn orbs (3-4 clicks), drag and apply orbs (3-4 drags), use a slider panel to fine-tune two coupled morph target pairs (2 adjustments where changing one affects the other), undo at least one application with Ctrl+Z, redo with Ctrl+Y, and press a Confirm button to lock the final expression. Each orb uses soft-body simulation with Verlet integration for vertices connected by spring constraints, giving visible wobble during flight and splash on impact. Show particle burst on orb absorption. Display step counter and energy conservation meter. Add OrbitControls restricted to upper hemisphere. All morph target names should be read dynamically from the facecap model. Render at 60fps with antialiasing enabled.
